extracted.intended_audience: aspiring Wattpad creators and new Wattpad writers
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for new writers on how to join Wattpad, publish and categorize stories, build a profile and community presence, and use Wattpad-specific storytelling formats and resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Wattpad 101
rubrics_metrics.description: Welcome to Wattpad! Introductory orientation to the platform and its creator community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level starting point for new users; points them to further resources in the Get started hub.

rubrics_metrics.name: Navigating Wattpad
rubrics_metrics.description: How to use the Wattpad app and website, including the five tabs and overall navigation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Download the app, create your account; note that every account requires a valid and verified email address to access all elements of the app and website.

rubrics_metrics.name: Getting connected
rubrics_metrics.description: How to become part of the Wattpad community and build relationships with readers and other creators.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides quick ways to get connected on Wattpad to build community and engagement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Personalizing your profile
rubrics_metrics.description: Customize your profile page to tell people about yourself prior to publishing stories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Keep in mind that your profile information will be visible to all users.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to publish your first story
rubrics_metrics.description: Steps to publish a simple or elaborate story on Wattpad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains options available to make your story understandable and discoverable.

rubrics_metrics.name: Categorizing your story on Wattpad
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on choosing Genres, Subgenres, and Fandoms for your story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stories don't fit into one box; Wattpad stories are layered—use the glossary of Genres, Subgenres, and Fandoms to categorize for discoverability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advice from Creators
rubrics_metrics.description: Collected writing advice from Wattpad creators on productivity, writer's block, and finding inspiration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Leverages community examples and tips to improve writing practice and workflow.

rubrics_metrics.name: Webnovel essentials
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources specific to the webnovel format and its conventions on Wattpad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers format-specific expectations for serialized webnovels (listed as a hub resource).

rubrics_metrics.name: Story and scene structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on structuring stories and individual scenes to create satisfying narrative flow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resource recommended for planning pacing, arcs, and scene-level beats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Character (GMCS)
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources focused on character development; listed as 'Character (GMCS)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented as a dedicated character resource within the hub (GMCS is listed in the navigation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Wattpad tropes and genres
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview and explanation of common tropes and genre conventions on Wattpad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps writers understand popular genre expectations and how to use or subvert tropes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Planning a story
rubrics_metrics.description: Resources and advice for planning plot, structure, and overall story roadmap.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Aids writers in outlining and organizing serialized or stand-alone narratives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Setting and worldbuilding
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on creating settings and building the world of your story.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers how to make settings believable and engaging for readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sentence-level writing
rubrics_metrics.description: Advice and resources focused on sentence craft, style, and prose at the line level.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targets clarity, tone, and readability to improve the quality of writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Serialized storytelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for writing and publishing stories in serialized (episodic) form on Wattpad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses pacing, episode structure, and strategies to keep readers returning.

rubrics_metrics.name: Writing diversity: tips for inclusive stories
rubrics_metrics.description: Advice for writing inclusively and handling diverse characters and perspectives responsibly.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides tips to promote respectful and accurate representation in stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunities and marketing tips
rubrics_metrics.description: Information on opportunities for creators and tips for marketing stories and growing readership.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers ways to increase discoverability, promotion avenues, and program opportunities on Wattpad.

rubrics_metrics.name: Community guidelines and safety
rubrics_metrics.description: Platform rules and safety guidance for creators and readers on Wattpad.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Points to community rules and safety resources to ensure compliance and protect users.
